objective.text: Preserve listener-specific queue routing independently of the event class.

difficulty.rationale: Route one listener’s work using its event payload without moving every listener to a shared queue.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A queued RenderPreview listener should use urgent for priority events and previews otherwise. The event has a boolean urgent property. Which listener method selects the queue name from that event?

options.text: failed($event), returning the queue name when no exception exists.
options.rationale: Failure handling does not select the destination for a normal dispatch.
options.misconception: Failure handling does not select the destination for a normal dispatch.

options.text: handle($event), returning the desired queue name before rendering.
options.rationale: The listener has already been routed and executed when handle returns.
options.misconception: The listener has already been routed and executed when handle returns.

options.rationale: The queued-listener dispatcher resolves the queue using this event-aware routing method.

options.text: shouldQueue($event), returning the queue name as a truthy string.
options.rationale: shouldQueue decides eligibility, not the destination queue.
options.misconception: shouldQueue decides eligibility, not the destination queue.
